channel.title: StudentOS Changelog
channel.description: Plain-English updates to StudentOS — what changed and why it matters for studying.

item.title: v2.9.4 — Claude-Sidebar Cream + Deeper Dashboard
item.description: Workspaces and sidebar move to Claude-sidebar cream with the dashboard one shade deeper and the sidebar selection kept visible.

item.title: v2.9.3 — Warm Cream Everywhere: Background Fix That Applies
item.description: Fixed the CSS layer bug that kept backgrounds pale — dashboard and all tabs now show warm cream with deeper rows and a softer sidebar.

item.title: v2.9.2 — Warmer Workspace + Richer Sidebar
item.description: Dashboard and workspace move to a warmer orange cream with the sidebar one shade richer.

item.title: v2.9.1 — Plain Warm Cream Background: Starry Wash Removed
item.description: The grey starry wallpaper wash is removed entirely — the dashboard sits on plain Claude-sidebar warm cream with the sidebar a touch deeper, and the space photo stays as a card.

item.title: v2.9.0 — Warm Cream Theme + Gentle Dark Mode + Lively Landing
item.description: Warm cream canvas everywhere with a deeper-cream sidebar, softer readable dark mode, and a brighter logged-out homepage with floating glows and scroll-reveal animations.

item.title: v2.8.4 — Warmer Look: No Grey Wash, Lighter Sidebar
item.description: Dashboard drops the grey wash for warm cream and the sidebar turns soft light orange with dark readable text.

item.title: v2.8.3 — Canvas Production Fix: Sync Works on Vercel + Single Error Message
item.description: Canvas /api routes now reach the serverless router on the live site so pasted keys actually sync, proxy error details are surfaced, and the banner never doubles the retry hint.

item.title: v2.8.2 — Canvas Save & Sync Fix: New Credentials Actually Sync
item.description: Pressing Save & Sync in Canvas now syncs with the credentials you just entered instead of silently loading nothing with no error.

item.title: v2.8.1 — Canvas Sync Fix: Honest Errors When the Server API Is Down
item.description: Canvas sync now detects a broken deployment (server API returning pages instead of JSON) and says so plainly, instead of blaming your token or feed link; bare vite dev proxies /api to the app server.

item.title: v2.8.0 — Math That Renders: KaTeX Formulas in Every AI Answer
item.description: Math formulas in Study Coach, Feynman, quizzes, PhotoMath and STEM Lab now render as real equations with KaTeX, theme-matched and Vietnamese-safe.

item.title: v2.7.0 — Claude Palette, VI/EN Toggle, Calmer Toolbars & Honest Canvas
item.description: Official Claude canvas/border/accent palette everywhere, Vietnamese-English toggle with auto-detect, decluttered Tracker toolbar with Filters panel and Smart Add AI Rank, single-banner Canvas errors that keep cached assignments, and a multi-section homepage with Features, How-it-works, FAQ and Privacy.

item.title: v2.6.1 — True Palette, Point-At-You Tour & Honest Canvas Errors
item.description: Strict Warm Cream/Charcoal/Terracotta palette on every screen, spotlight tour that points at real buttons and auto-moves tabs, Canvas expired-feed and bad-token errors with fixes, and no more collapsed same-name assignments.

item.title: v2.6.0 — Everyday Polish: deadlines, focus & search feel instant
item.description: Tracker urgency badges and relative due dates, dashboard countdowns, timetable now-line, calmer Pomodoro, mood check-in, faster search with math copy and recents, Gmail unread badges, Drive sorting, CSV export, habits streaks and one-click citation copy.

item.title: v2.5.1 — True Two-Mode Theme, Calmer Home & Fixed App Icons
item.description: Exactly two modes: Warm Cream light and Dark Charcoal dark with terracotta accent. Simpler home, cleaner sidebar, every app icon unique.

item.title: v2.5.0 — Division A Kit: Home Fix, NASA Repair, AI Labs & Dossier
item.description: Getting-started card below Today Plan, NASA Image of the Day with retry, offline Train My Model Lab, Few-Shot Lab and Competition Dossier with PDF export.

item.title: v2.4.2 — Fixed: Google Sign-In That Would Not Finish
item.description: Clear sign-in errors with fixes, redirect sign-in for blocked popups, welcome-back sync, one-tap connection check.

item.title: v2.4.1 — Fixed: Blank Canvas Page & Google Sign-In Going Stale
item.description: One bad assignment row can no longer blank the Canvas page. Clear error with retry, permanent Google connection, cached data kept on failed sync.

item.title: v2.4.0 — Smarter studying: auto-scheduler, grade forecaster, voice + 15 new tools
item.description: One-tap focus planner, GPA what-if simulator, exam countdowns, teacher follow-ups, voice dictation, offline trash + history, and new workspaces (jobs, budget, code runner, resume).
